capacity.enabled.label: Enable Capacity Controller
capacity.enabled.help: Experimental feature. When enabled, the controller actively intervenes (e.g., compressing, rewriting transcript) when context approaches the model's upper limit, which may alter conversation history.

capacity.low_risk_max.label: Low Risk Max Ratio
capacity.low_risk_max.help: Context usage below 50% is considered low risk, no intervention needed.

capacity.medium_risk_max.label: Medium Risk Max Ratio
capacity.medium_risk_max.help: Usage between 50%~62% is medium risk, start warning.

capacity.severe_min_slack.label: Severe Min Slack
capacity.severe_min_slack.help: Negative values allow brief overshoot but trigger emergency compression.

capacity.severe_violation_ratio.label: Severe Violation Ratio
capacity.severe_violation_ratio.help: Considered a severe violation when actual usage exceeds the expected ratio by 40%.

capacity.refresh_cooldown_turns.label: Refresh Cooldown Turns
capacity.refresh_cooldown_turns.help: Minimum number of turns between two context refresh operations to prevent frequent jitter.

capacity.replan_cooldown_turns.label: Replan Cooldown Turns
capacity.replan_cooldown_turns.help: Minimum number of turns between two replanning operations.

capacity.max_replay_per_turn.label: Max Replay Per Turn
capacity.max_replay_per_turn.help: Maximum number of times historical content can be replayed into the prompt within a single turn.

capacity.min_turns_before_guardrail.label: Min Turns Before Guardrail
capacity.min_turns_before_guardrail.help: Minimum number of turns after session start before enabling capacity guardrails, leaving room for initial setup.

capacity.profile_window.label: Profile Window
capacity.profile_window.help: The capacity controller analyzes token usage trends over how many recent turns.

capacity.deepseek_v3_2_chat_prior.label: V3.2 Chat Priority
capacity.deepseek_v3_2_chat_prior.help: Context priority weight when using V3.2 Chat model.

capacity.deepseek_v3_2_reasoner_prior.label: V3.2 Reasoner Priority
capacity.deepseek_v3_2_reasoner_prior.help: Weight when using V3.2 Reasoner model (slightly higher than Chat, because reasoning consumes more).

capacity.deepseek_v4_flash_prior.label: V4 Flash Priority
capacity.deepseek_v4_flash_prior.help: Weight for V4 Flash (highest, because Flash is used for coordination and needs more context headroom).
